evidence.note: The name occurs first with prefixed ל as Jesse’s son and then without the prefix as Solomon’s father.
Ruth’s genealogy likewise identifies David as Jesse’s son.
The Hebrew noun דּוֹד denotes a beloved one and supplies the possible comparison for the name.

name: דַּוִידֿ
summary: Matthew’s Syriac genealogy calls Jesse’s son David the king and names Solomon as his son. The Hebrew name resembles the noun for a beloved one, though the genealogy gives no explanation of the name.
